title: A split-screen composition for a high-end furniture brand. Left side: 6 neat, minimalist flat cardboard boxes stacked against a warm porcelain wall. Right side: A stunning, sun-drenched Japandi living room and bedroom featuring a modular terracotta-colored sofa, a warm oak flat-pack coffee table, and a minimalist bed frame. The transition between the boxes and the room feels magical and seamless. Professional interior photography, soft natural lighting, tactile textures.
